title: Effects of exercise on cognitive function in older patients with Alzheimer's disease: a meta-regression and meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

answer.design_quote: All included trials were randomized controlled trials (RCTs) involving adults aged 60 years and above. These studies examined the effects of exercise intervention on cognitive function in AD patients, compared with passive control groups without exercise.
answer.k_quote: Data from 23 studies, involving 1,868 adults, were included.
